description: Defines CPU feature enumeration, runtime support functions, and related utilities for x86_64 and AArch64 architectures.

classes.name: ocudu::cpu_feature
classes.description: Enumeration of CPU features supported on x86_64 and AArch64 architectures.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts a cpu_feature enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: cpu_supports_feature
methods.description: Checks at runtime if a specific CPU feature is supported.

methods.name: get_cpu_feature_info
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing supported CPU features.

methods.name: cpu_supports_included_features
methods.description: Checks if all included CPU features are supported.
